sections.name: Intro
sections.style_notes: one plucked guitar alone, lots of space, no drums, no bass

sections.name: Hook
lines: Ten years on, another life, another shore
I don't think about the fights anymore
I think about the roads, and the beaches we found
Sitting side by side while the sun went down
sections.style_notes: whispered close vocal over the pluck only, no drums

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Five a.m., the sea at Hua Hin like glass
We'd swim out before the town woke up
Fruit from the market in a plastic bag
We'd eat it on the motorbike, and that was enough
sections.style_notes: still no drums, single intimate vocal, soft pad fades in

sections.name: Pre-Chorus
lines: We were fire and fire, we could burn the whole night down
Then water, the calmest sea around
sections.style_notes: finger snaps enter, a harmony joins, tension rising

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Ten years on, another life, another shore
I don't think about the fights anymore
I think about the roads, and the beaches we found
Sitting side by side while the sun went down
And every year they light the candles, and I think of you
'Cause it's your birthday too
sections.style_notes: full beat and deep bass drop in all at once, wide stacked harmonies

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Forty kilometres on the motorbike
Any makeshift room would do for the night
We had next to nothing, and we had it all
Another empty beach, watching the sun fall
sections.style_notes: beat thins to kick and snaps, rolling, like the open road

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: We could do it cheap, we could do it grand
You were just as happy with a street-food stand
A few drinks deep, then home, and you'd put Faded on
We'd be asleep before the end of the song
sections.style_notes: same light groove, playful and warm
